Analytical buyers who compare specification sheets will appreciate how this truck maximizes value in both luxury and utility. Key equipment like the Bed Utility Group, Trailer Tow Group, and adaptive features such as adjustable pedals and memory seating come standard, streamlining the buying process by reducing the need for additional packages. In climates like Lakeland, FL, the inclusion of dual-zone automatic climate control and rain-sensing wipers increases everyday comfort and convenience, directly translating to real-life savings and satisfaction. This configuration is well-suited for those who demand both refinement and capability without hidden upcharges.

Owners benefit from a strong balance of power and efficiency, with EPA ratings of 15 mpg city and 21 mpg highway, which are competitive figures among full-size crew cab pickups. The 4WD capability delivers traction and confidence for hauling or navigating adverse weather, while the auto-leveling suspension and independent front suspension contribute to a composed, comfortable ride. Maintenance costs are kept manageable thanks to proven component reliability and the widespread availability of service expertise for Ram trucks.

Standard safety technology on the Ram 1500 Tungsten underscores its value proposition. Advanced features such as ABS brakes, electronic stability control, and a full suite of airbags—including dual front, side, and overhead airbags—are included at no extra cost. The truck also features rain-sensing wipers, auto high-beam headlights, and brake assist, which are typically part of optional safety packages on many competitors. Functional enhancements like blind spot monitoring and rearview cameras are notably absent from some rivals’ base models, while this truck ensures core safety tech is part of the standard equipment list, delivering peace of mind and strong safety value.

The Tungsten trim comes fully loaded with features often reserved for higher-priced models or expensive upgrades elsewhere. Standard highlights include the Quick Order Package 22V Tungsten, premium leather seating, heated and ventilated seats in both rows, a heated steering wheel, and a power moonroof. The Uconnect 5 Nav system with a 14.4-inch display, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, navigation, and a heads-up display transform daily driving into a connected, intuitive experience. The power-folding mirrors, adjustable pedals, and memory functions for seating and pedals further enhance the driver’s convenience. Trailer Tow and Bed Utility Groups add significant functional value for those needing utility without extra fees.

When evaluating the Ram 1500 Tungsten against direct competitors like the Ford F-150 Platinum and Chevrolet Silverado 1500 High Country, its feature-to-price ratio stands out.

What’s included as standard equipment? The Tungsten trim packs in premium leather, advanced connectivity, heated/ventilated seats, navigation, and enhanced towing features at no extra cost. Is this truck worth the price? Yes, as it delivers luxury and utility standard, which often cost thousands more on competitors.

Recent Arrival!

• Power front seats with driver memory and power lumbar support help make it easier to find a comfortable driving position.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

Heated and ventilated front seats adjust to your preferences, while the leather-appointed interior conveys sophistication. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, and dual-zone automatic climate control ensures everyone travels in comfort. Navigation, SiriusXM satellite radio, and a premium JBL audio system transform every drive into an engaging experience.

This vehicle comes certified with Toyota's rigorous quality standards, meaning it has undergone comprehensive inspection and meets strict performance criteria. You can trust that this Tundra has been thoroughly evaluated to deliver dependable service for years to come.

The technology suite keeps you connected and in control. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto bring your smartphone interface to the dashboard, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you adjust settings without taking your hands off the wheel. The rear view camera, parking sensors, and blind spot monitor work together to make maneuvering easier and safer, whether you're backing into a tight parking space or surveying your surroundings on busy roads.

Practical features enhance the ownership experience throughout the truck bed and cabin. Power running boards make climbing into the Tundra effortless, while the spray-on bed liner protects your investment during work or recreation. All-weather floor liners keep the cabin clean, and the dash cam records your journey for added peace of mind. The heated steering wheel and memory seat settings personalize your driving experience with the push of a button.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this capable Tundra Hybrid Platinum firsthand. Our team is ready to discuss how this truck can serve your needs, answer your questions, and help you understand why Tundra owners return generation after generation.

description: 2025 Ford F-150 XLT 4WD SuperCrew 5.5 Box EcoBoost 3.5L V-6 port/direct injection, DOHC, Ti-VCT variable valve control, twin turbo, regular unleaded, 430 HP, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. This full-size pickup blends strong twin-turbo power and a smooth-shifting gearbox to handle heavy towing and hauling while staying mindful of fuel economy, making it a capable choice for workdays and weekend drives alike. SYNC 4 AppLink with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps navigation, calls and apps available without cords, so you can access your phone’s essentials safely and seamlessly while driving. *Front pedestrian impact prevention* continuously watches the road ahead and can take action to reduce the likelihood or severity of a collision with pedestrians, adding peace of mind in crowded neighborhoods and city streets. A built-in *mobile hotspot* lets passengers stay online on the road ideal for streaming, remote work or keeping kids entertained without using up individual phone data plans. The *rear camera* gives a clearer view of what’s behind the truck, simplifying backing, parking and trailer hookup so you can maneuver with greater confidence. *Lane departure prevention* helps correct unintentional drifting, easing driver fatigue on long highway runs and supporting safer lane-keeping when you need it most. *Rear collision mitigation* monitors traffic approaching from behind and prepares the vehicle and occupants if an impact appears likely, aiming to lessen damage and improve occupant protection. *Brake assist* detects panic braking and applies maximum available brake boost to help shorten stopping distance in emergencies, helping you react quickly when seconds count. Cruise control with steering wheel-mounted controls lets you set and adjust speed without taking your hands off the wheel, smoothing long trips and helping maintain steady fuel usage. A responsive *touchscreen* places infotainment and vehicle controls at your fingertips for quick, intuitive adjustments so you can keep your attention on the road. Full-time *4-wheel drive* delivers traction to all four wheels for improved stability in rain, snow or loose surfaces, increasing confidence when conditions turn challenging. *Part-time 4-wheel/all-wheel drive* provides the flexibility to engage extra traction only when you need it, balancing everyday efficiency with added capability for off-road or deep-snow situations. Equipped with a potent EcoBoost V6, modern connectivity and a suite of active safety systems, the 2025 F-150 XLT 4WD SuperCrew 5.5 Box is built to handle demanding jobs while keeping occupants comfortable and connected. Whether you need a reliable work truck or a versatile family hauler, this F-150 offers a practical mix of capability, convenience and confidence schedule a test drive to see how it fits your routine.
